title: llm-kit run import line, version 1
description: One line of a run import file (JSON Lines, UTF-8): one record event and the blobs it brings. Each key of blobs is a blob reference blob:<64 lowercase hex>, and its value is the bytes as text (UTF-8) or base64; the SHA-256 of those bytes equals the reference (reader rule). The record is validated as llm-kit.run-record/v1. Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. Contract: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.
